description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the land acquired in Heenkenda Gama & Kurukulawa Gama, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired by the State, including location details, plot numbers, extents, and compensation deposits. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
